name: Ice Gargoyle Reaver

alignment.name: Evil
alignment.description:
Evil creatures don’t necessarily go out of their way to hurt people, but they’re perfectly willing to take advantage of the weakness of others to acquire what they want.
	Evil creatures use rules and order to maximize personal gain. They don’t care whether laws hurt other people. They support institutional structures that give them power, even if that power comes at the expense of others’ freedom. Slavery and rigid caste structures are not only acceptable but desirable to evil creatures, as long as they are in a position to benefit from them.

weaknesses.name: Fire
weaknesses.details: (the ice gargoyle reaver grants combat advantage until the end of the attacker’s next turn)

description: Creatures larger than Medium take up more than 1 square. For instance, an ogre takes up a space that is 2 squares by 2 squares. Most Large and larger creatures also have a reach greater than 1, which means they can make melee attacks against creatures that aren’t adjacent to them. A creature’s basic body shape usually determines its reach; a Large ogre has a reach of 2, but a Large horse has a reach of 1.

traits.name: Freezing Gaze
traits.details: requires the ice gargoyle reaver to be in its ice prison; an enemy that enters or starts its turn within the aura is weakened until the start of its next turn and takes 5 cold damage.

auras.name: Freezing Gaze
auras.details: requires the ice gargoyle reaver to be in its ice prison; an enemy that enters or starts its turn within the aura is weakened until the start of its next turn and takes 5 cold damage.

hit.description: damage, and ongoing 5 cold damage (save ends)
cold damage (3d6 + 5 cold damage against a weakened target), the target gains vulnerable 5 cold (save ends), and the ice gargoyle reaver regains 5 hit points

effect.description: The ice gargoyle reaver flies 8 squares and makes a melee basic attack at the end of that movement. If the attack hits, the target is grabbed. The ice gargoyle reaver can try to move the grabbed target as part of its next move action. If it succeeds, it can move or fly at full speed, pulling the target with it

powers.name: Ice Prison
powers.description: The target is slowed and weakened until the end of the ice gargoyle reaver’s next turn. Each time a target the ice gargoyle reaver is grabbing takes the ongoing cold damage, the ice gargoyle reaver regains 5 hit points. The ice gargoyle reaver can take no actions in the ice prison, other than to end the effect (a minor action). If the gargoyle takes damage in this form, the ice prison is broken, freeing the grabbed target as if it saved and ending the grab.

effect.description: The ice gargoyle reaver encases itself and anyone it is grabbing in ice. In this form, the ice gargoyle reaver and any target it is grabbing gain resist 20 all, except against the cold damage dealt by this power. Both can still see their surroundings, but they cannot use other normal senses. A target the ice gargoyle reaver is grabbing is stunned, restrained, and takes ongoing 20 cold damage (save ends all, ending the grab and ice prison).

aftereffects.description: The target is slowed and weakened until the end of the ice gargoyle reaver’s next turn.
